name: Topological Acoustic Knots
description: Nematic Q-tensor film read between crossed polarizers: true plaquette-winding disclinations (half-integer blue, integer red), Michel-Levy retardance colours that follow the order parameter, a trefoil thickness wedge, and brush counts of 2 or 4 per core. Bass melts the order and re-quenches domains (Kibble-Zurek), mids sweep the polarizer, treble adds phonon waves, the mouse pins the director radially and clicks spawn defect loops.
